name: app_event.v1
description: One app_event/v1 timeline entry (docs/08 §2.1): an EventTracker ring-buffer entry, used identically in three places — session_create_request.v1.json's 'recent_events' items, the ctx.event data-channel payload (docs/13 §4), and this file, which is the shape all three defer to. The taxonomy is 'intentionally closed — a new event type is a protocol version bump, not a config flag' (docs/08 §2.1), so 'type' is a closed enum here, unlike error_code-style strings elsewhere in this protocol family that stay open on purpose. Every entry carries {type, name, ts} (docs/08 §2.1 canon); each type adds the fields in its docs/08 §2.1 table row. Deliberately excluded, per docs/08 §2.3: raw keystrokes, values of sensitive fields (omitted, not redacted-in-place — the field is simply absent), scroll positions, typing cadence, and anything outside VyaparPay's process. additionalProperties is left unset (docs/13 §9 additive-within-v1 posture), matching data_channel_envelope.v1.json/session_create_response.v1.json rather than the protocol/tools/*.json request-input style.

name.description: Meaning depends on type (docs/08 §2.1 'name carries' column): destination route for nav, target label/testTag for tap, field testTag/label for input, 'METHOD path' for api_error, dialog title for dialog.

ts.description: When the event happened on-device, epoch milliseconds (docs/08 §2.1).

nav_event.description: Fired by NavigationTracker's destination-changed listener (docs/08 §2.1). name is the destination route.

tap_event.description: Fired by the shared clickable modifier's click hook in :core:ui (docs/08 §2.1).

screen.description: The route the tap happened on (docs/08 §2.1).

input_event.description: Fired on field COMMIT only (focus loss or IME done) — never per keystroke (docs/08 §2.1, §2.3). value is present only for non-sensitive field classes and omitted entirely otherwise (docs/08 §2.1: 'the event omits the value rather than sending [REDACTED]' — a deliberate asymmetry from the snapshot's in-place redaction marker, docs/07 §5 rule 6), which is why value is optional here rather than required-and-nullable.

value.description: Committed field value; absent for sensitive field classes (docs/08 §2.1).

api_error_event.description: Fired by the core:network interceptor on any non-2xx response (docs/08 §2.1). name is 'METHOD path'.

code.description: docs/13 §1.1 error-code vocabulary — the same string across the HTTP body, this event, and the ScreenContext IR's last_api.error_code (docs/13 §1: 'one vocabulary'). Deliberately not an enum: new codes may be added within a class without a version bump (docs/13 §1.1, §9).

dialog_event.description: Fired on dialog window attach/detach — the same hook as the docs/07 §2.1 capture bypass (docs/08 §2.1). name is the dialog title.

visible.description: true on attach, false on detach (docs/08 §2.1).
